nodes.label: MOps Command Center skill
nodes.rationale: Composition/shared-brain layer over existing MOps skills (not a new codebase); computes the manager KPIs once so the dashboard and routine never re-derive them. Read-only because Salesforce MCP is query-only and to keep the reporting surface safe.

nodes.label: briefing object (shared KPI snapshot)
nodes.rationale: One fixed-shape object is the single source of truth both dashboard surfaces and the routine consume; nulls + dataGaps[] instead of fabricated numbers so gaps stay visible.

nodes.label: On-time SLA % metric
nodes.rationale: Computed from real business-day turnaround (created_at->completed_at) because the Asana 'Out of SLA/Rush' flag is populated on ~1/35 tickets and reads a false ~97%. Webinar/Event excluded because their SLAs are requestor lead-time before the live event, not MOps turnaround.

nodes.label: Turnaround SLA table (by Project Type)
nodes.rationale: Business-day SLAs keyed to the Asana Project Type enum, approximated where the enum is coarser than the SLA doc (e.g. multiple->2bd, single-email 5bd applied to multi-send too).

nodes.label: Triage speed (assignment lag) metric
nodes.rationale: Front-half of cycle time; two honesty adjustments (self-assignment share, true-triage subset where assigner!=creator) so a near-zero median isn't read as instant triage.

nodes.label: Email campaign performance section
nodes.rationale: Salesforce is the system of record for Pardot rollups (no Pardot connector); known sync gaps (NumberSent=0, subject lines unsynced, CampaignMember responder-biased) reported as unavailable, never estimated.

nodes.label: Jira intake channel (second front-door)
nodes.rationale: MOPS Jira project is a parallel request front-door the Asana-only view missed; splits real vs automated privacy/DSAR noise, flags orphaned tickets on deactivated assignees, and ages by created (not updated, which a bulk edit reset).

nodes.label: Jira Close write action
nodes.rationale: MOPS Jira workflow is forward-only/linear and Done is terminal (no reopen transition), so Close chains transitions live to Done, sets a required resolution, warns it's one-way, and is not auto-retried.

nodes.label: Threshold checks / alerts[]
nodes.rationale: Each tripped threshold becomes one severity-tagged alert so the routine can decide what interrupts the day (warn/critical) vs. rides the morning brief (info).

nodes.label: pipeline-influenced-email metric skill
nodes.rationale: Single source of truth for email->pipeline $, from Salesforce Campaign opportunity rollups. Reports won counts not won $ (AmountWonOpportunities unreliable), no ROI (cost fields null), and warns pipeline lags the send so recent windows look lower.

nodes.label: AmountAllOpportunities (Campaign rollup)
nodes.rationale: Single-touch (Primary Campaign Source) attribution; per-campaign values are each primary-source so summing is additive but undercounts email's assist role.

nodes.label: MOps Command Center routine (blueprint)
nodes.rationale: Two triggers share one repo/skill (a single routine has one cron); publishes only the snapshot dashboard form (the mcp live form needs an interactive session).

nodes.label: MOps Requests SLA Timeline Requirements (2025)
nodes.rationale: Authoritative SLA reference; distinguishes turnaround SLAs (SFDC/UTM/Email/Form/Reporting) from requestor lead-time before the live event (Webinar 2wk / Event 4wk), which is why Webinar/Event are excluded from the on-time %.

nodes.label: Weekly send-day ownership / 3-per-week cap
nodes.rationale: Mon webinars / Tue nurture / Wed ABM / Thu events / Fri rest; max 3 marketing emails per record per week per audience — send-calendar clash flagging aligns to these rules.

nodes.label: Driver: audience precision
nodes.rationale: Engagement/efficiency rise monotonically as audience shrinks; targeted (<1k) sends earn ~4.4x open, ~7.6x CTR, ~6x pipeline/1k of the mass blast — tighter targeting is the biggest controllable lever.

nodes.label: Finding: Q2 CTR/CTOR collapse
nodes.rationale: CTR halved QoQ (1.00%->0.51%) with opens flat -> a content/CTA/relevance problem after the open, not deliverability and not pipeline lag; the most actionable finding of the quarter.

nodes.label: Decision: Command Center as composition layer (2026-07-20)
nodes.rationale: Existing reporting skills pulled the same data on separate cadences with no single surface; built a read-only briefing skill + live dashboard + proactive routine. Salesforce MCP is read-only, so writable actions limited to Asana/Slack/Jira.

nodes.label: Decision: real on-time SLA model (2026-07-21)
nodes.rationale: Replaced the false 97% from the near-empty 'Out of SLA/Rush' flag with business-day turnaround vs per-type SLA; Webinar/Event excluded as lead-time not turnaround; later aligned to the official 2025 SLA doc.

nodes.label: Decision: Jira intake channel + Close action (2026-07-28)
nodes.rationale: MOPS Jira is a second intake front-door under-reported by the Asana-only view; Close chains forward-only transitions to terminal Done with a required resolution and no auto-retry, first real close made knowingly by the manager.
